title: The Role of Digital Banking Features in Bank Selection: An Analysis of Customer Preferences for Online and Mobile Banking
authors: Faisal, N. A.; Nahar, J.; Waliullah, M.; Borna, R. S.
venue: Frontiers in Applied Engineering and Technology
tldr: Digital banking features including convenience, security, personalization, and 24/7 availability are key factors in customer bank selection preferences.
problem_and_motivation: Understanding which digital banking features influence customer bank selection is essential for financial institutions competing in an increasingly digital marketplace accelerated by COVID-19.
approach: Systematic literature review of 112 peer-reviewed articles on digital banking adoption and effectiveness.
Examines key themes: convenience, security, personalization, competitive innovation, and crisis resilience.
Analyzes customer preferences for online and mobile banking features.
findings: User-friendly interfaces, 24/7 availability, and seamless transactions are critical digital banking features.
Security concerns remain a significant factor in customer bank selection.
Personalization features increasingly influence customer preferences.
COVID-19 accelerated digital banking adoption and changed customer expectations.

definitions.definition: Online and mobile banking services enabling remote financial transactions and account management.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: Provides a synthesized view of digital banking features that influence customer bank selection. Identifies convenience, security, and personalization as key differentiators in the competitive banking landscape.
directly_justifies: User-friendly interfaces and 24/7 availability are critical digital banking features.
Security concerns significantly influence customer bank selection.
limits: Literature review without primary empirical data.
Focus on feature preferences, not behavioral outcomes. [unacknowledged]

limitations: Literature review without primary empirical validation.
Does not address post-adoption behavioral outcomes. [unacknowledged]

User-friendly interfaces and 24/7 availability are critical features.
